liturgicalName: Palm Sunday of the Passion of the Lord
keyVerseDR: "Hosanna to the son of David: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord..." (Mt 21:9)

level1.title: Hosanna!
level1.story: Jesus rode a donkey into Jerusalem. People waved palm branches. They shouted, "Hosanna!"
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, my King, I love You. Amen.

activity.title: Into Jerusalem
activity.intro: Help the donkey carry Jesus into the city. Shout Hosanna!

level2.title: The King on a Donkey
level2.story: As Jesus came near Jerusalem, He sent two disciples to bring a donkey and its colt. Jesus rode into the city, and the crowds spread their cloaks and branches on the road. They shouted, "Hosanna to the Son of David! Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord!" The whole city asked, "Who is this?" This week we remember how Jesus suffered and died on the cross for us.
level2.keyLine: Blessed is he that cometh in the name of the Lord.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did the crowd change from praise to 'Crucify him'?
How will you walk with Jesus this Holy Week?
level2.prayer: Jesus, thank You for dying for me. Amen.

activity.title: Holy Week in order
activity.intro: Number what happened to Jesus in order.
